name: Override: autonomous with the left Toggle and a stack
description: Starts with its back 1 in off red's wall in the middle of the left Toggle and rolls it to red, pushing back at 3 V. Then it takes the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5) as the stack example does, and sets it on the Pin in the neutral left Goal. The left Toggle is red, so red scores 20: both halves of the stack's yellow Pin. The Goal's own Pin shows nothing, its bottom half in the Goal and its top half in the stack Cup's gray half (SC3). That is 2 of the 6 Pin halves the Autonomous Win Point needs, on 1 of the 2 Goals; the partner robot has to place the other 4, on a second Goal as well. Drives speed up at 0.3 V per 10 ms so the wheels don't spin at launch. Turning the bottom Toggle as well takes the robot past the end of the 15 s autonomous.

steps.note: aim 0.53 in right of the stack; the robot's middle slides as it turns
the bite until the stack is under the claw's middle
close on the Cup and the Pin
toward the Goal, the lift still down
the bite onto the Goal, the stack well over its Pin; the Goal stops it 1.1 s in
set the Cup's rim on the Goal's Pin
back away, then lower the lift
